pickup.Dough: Vertical down/up, contact at widest belly. No sideways motion before lifted and drawer closed.
pickup.Cola: Vertical down/up; raise360mm before drawer closes. Try12mm deeper seating.
pickup.Dessert: Vertical down/up; try deeper seating, must not intersect body or neighbouring cups.
pickup.Box: V2 horizontal centre of front edge, closed uncut carton. Deep requested entry26mm. Two-fixed alternative: user requested vertical approach, no carton holes; check actual feasibility instead of forcing contact.

release.Dough: Same accepted20deg upper diagonal, top view straight. Same table and opener trial95mm lift.
release.Cola: Horizontal near right wall same shelf.
release.Dessert: Near robot in front of cola; no top-view diagonal.30deg pitch only where clearance requires.
release.Box: Same shelf layout, no carton cuts, centre edge.

blocked_grasps: User-requested full conceptual motion: carry assumed even when contacts or gaps exist; no collision stop; no physical grasp qualification.
product_paths: *_v8_candidate.json contain full desired paths and product transforms; rerun IK for own head TCP and verify, never claim the old head checks apply.
same_deformation_for_BMC: finger_bend.py/finger-bend.js preserves upper shoulder. Exact neutral STEP, approximate bend. Sign/orientation must match each mounting; no whole-body shear. DAC-2GN4087 alternate uses its own catalogue model, NOT this BMC curve.

dough_belly_measurement.method: Maximum X span of201 horizontal native product sections
